policy: These are improvement targets, not promotion conditions. None of them being at 100% is a reason to keep improving the recommender; it is not a reason to withhold a catalog that keeps every valid candidate reachable. Requiring a perfect ranker before shipping the safety net is what kept the previous three stages from delivering anything.

targets.note: Share of the first three recommendations that are progressions, when three or more progression patterns exist.
New: must-show blocks reachable from the recommendation list.
Distinct patterns among the recommendations, over the recommendation count.
Spread of recommended spans across the song.
Not measurable yet; recorded so it is not forgotten.
Requires product telemetry that does not exist. Deferred.

regressionFloor.note: Recommendation v1 is not made the default if any of these fires. The catalog may still be promoted — see 00-catalog-hard-gates.json.
